system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: logging-sink-bigquery-dataset
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:datasets
  properties:
    datasetReference:
      datasetId: logging_sink_dataset
    location: US
    description: "Dataset for storing exported Cloud Logging data"
    defaultTableExpirationMs: 2592000000
    access:
    - role: OWNER
      specialGroup: projectOwners
    - role: READER
      specialGroup: projectReaders
    - role: WRITER
      specialGroup: projectWriters

- name: logging-sink-bigquery-table
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:tables
  properties:
    datasetId: $(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    tableReference:
      tableId: log_entries
    schema:
      fields:
      - name: timestamp
        type: TIMESTAMP
        mode: REQUIRED
      - name: logName
        type: STRING
        mode: NULLABLE
      - name: resource
        type: RECORD
        mode: NULLABLE
        fields:
        - name: type
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: labels
          type: RECORD
          mode: REPEATED
          fields:
          - name: key
            type: STRING
            mode: NULLABLE
          - name: value
            type: STRING
            mode: NULLABLE
      - name: jsonPayload
        type: STRING
        mode: NULLABLE
      - name: textPayload
        type: STRING
        mode: NULLABLE
      - name: severity
        type: STRING
        mode: NULLABLE
      - name: insertId
        type: STRING
        mode: NULLABLE
      - name: httpRequest
        type: RECORD
        mode: NULLABLE
        fields:
        - name: requestMethod
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: requestUrl
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: status
          type: INTEGER
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: userAgent
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: remoteIp
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: referer
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: latency
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: cacheLookup
          type: BOOLEAN
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: cacheHit
          type: BOOLEAN
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: cacheValidatedWithOriginServer
          type: BOOLEAN
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: cacheFillBytes
          type: INTEGER
          mode: NULLABLE
        - name: protocol
          type: STRING
          mode: NULLABLE
    timePartitioning:
      type: DAY
      expirationMs: 2592000000
    clustering:
      fields:
      - severity
      - resource.type

- name: logging-sink-service-account
  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
  properties:
    accountId: logging-sink-sa
    displayName: "Service account for Cloud Logging sink to BigQuery"

- name: logging-sink-bigquery-dataset-iam
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:datasets/setIamPolicy
  properties:
    datasetId: $(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/bigquery.dataEditor
        members:
        - serviceAccount: $(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)
      - role: roles/bigquery.user
        members:
        - serviceAccount: $(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)

- name: project-logging-sink
  type: gcp-types/logging-v2:sinks
  properties:
    name: project-log-export-to-bigquery
    destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/{{ env["project"] }}/datasets/$(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    filter: "resource.type=\"gce_instance\" OR resource.type=\"gae_app\" OR resource.type=\"cloud_function\""
    writerIdentity: $(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)
    bigqueryOptions:
      usePartitionedTables: true
      usesTimestampColumnPartitioning: true

- name: logging-sink-service-account-iam
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    projectId: {{ env["project"] }}
    member: $(ref.project-logging-sink.writerIdentity)
    role: roles/logging.logWriter

outputs:
- name: bigqueryDatasetId
  value: $(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
- name: bigqueryTableId
  value: $(ref.logging-sink-bigquery-table.tableReference.tableId)
- name: serviceAccountEmail
  value: $(ref.logging-sink-service-account.email)
- name: loggingSinkName
  value: $(ref.project-logging-sink.name)
